name: spatial_proximity
description: The subject and object are spatially close or near each other.

name: physical_contact
description: The subject and object physically touch or make contact.

name: spatial_overlap
description: The subject and object visually overlap or intersect in the image.

name: support_surface
description: One object supports the other from below or acts as a stable surface.

name: vertical_above
description: The subject is vertically above or higher than the object.

name: vertical_below
description: The subject is vertically below or lower than the object.

name: front_depth
description: The subject is in front of the object in depth or viewing order.

name: behind_occlusion
description: The subject is behind the object or partly hidden by it.

name: containment_inside
description: The subject is inside, within, or enclosed by the object.

name: covering_surface
description: The subject covers, coats, or lies over the visible surface of the object.

name: attachment_connection
description: The subject is attached, connected, fixed, or fastened to the object.

name: part_whole_possession
description: The subject is a part, component, attribute, or possession of the object.

name: holding_grasping_carrying
description: The subject is held, grasped, carried, or moved by an agent.

name: wearing_body_contact
description: The subject is worn on or attached to a body part.

name: riding_mounted
description: The subject is riding, mounted on, or positioned on the back of the object.

name: body_posture
description: The relation involves a body posture such as sitting, standing, or lying.

name: locomotion_walking
description: The relation involves walking or locomotion through or on a place.

name: visual_attention
description: The subject visually attends to, looks at, or watches the object.

name: using_tool_function
description: The subject uses the object as a tool, instrument, or functional aid.

name: playing_activity
description: The subject is engaged in play, sport, or recreational activity with the object.

name: eating_ingestion
description: The subject eats, bites, or consumes the object.

name: flying_motion
description: The subject is flying or moving through the air in a region.

name: hanging_suspended
description: The subject hangs from or is suspended by the object.

name: source_origin
description: The subject originates from, comes from, or is separated from the object.

name: destination_purpose
description: The subject is directed to, intended for, or associated with a purpose involving the object.

name: material_composition
description: The subject is made of, composed of, or formed from the object material.

name: text_symbol_surface
description: The subject is text, writing, symbol, picture, or paint displayed on the object.

name: growth_biological
description: The subject grows on or is biologically rooted in the object.

name: path_across_along
description: The subject extends, moves, or lies across or along the object.

name: between_multiple
description: The subject is between multiple objects or located in an intermediate spatial region.

name: association_with
description: The subject and object are associated, co-present, or paired without a specific physical relation.

name: generic_relation
description: The subject and object have a broad semantic relation that is underspecified by visual primitives.
